description: x402-poly-quote: One normalized read of a Polymarket market across three upstreams — Gamma (outcome prices, best bid/ask, spread, 24h volume, liquidity, tick size), CLOB (the top three order-book levels on each side, correct end of the book) and Data API v2 (open interest). Returns age_seconds so staleness is visible, and never places orders. Pass `market` as a slug or 0x… conditionId; add `token` to pick a specific outcome's book.
name: x402-poly-quote
